page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core execution is relatively weak, as shown by bottom 25% results in stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core tests, alongside a poor bottom 10% result in single-threaded gzip compression. However, the 32 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance, placing in the middle 50% for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks also performs within the average range.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.g5ne.8xlarge provides moderate resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for multi-threaded workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. It is suited for general-purpose applications, static web serving, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and database operations, where parallel processing can offset the weaker single-core performance.
